title: High-touch prospect bucketizer and Implementation Readiness Index
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and CS teams receive multi-part, high-touch enterprise feature asks that are hard to triage consistently. Current intake produces long free-text tickets that require repeated follow-ups, delaying scoping and skewing prioritization toward the loudest accounts.

Goal: Build a lightweight "bucketizer" that assigns high-touch asks into a small set of canonical buckets (e.g., integrations, performance SLOs, private deployment, RBAC/compliance, custom routing) and compute an Implementation Readiness Index (IRI) for each ask. The IRI is a single score combining economic signal, technical feasibility, and compliance/ops blockers to accelerate first-pass scoping and flag items that need security/infra involvement.

Scope (MVP):
- Minimal UI form for Sales/CS to submit structured fields + free-text (team, account tier, ask type, desired timeline, rough econ signal).
- Backend bucket classification rules (heuristic + quick model for ambiguous cases).
- IRI computation prototype with three sub-scores: econ (deal size / ARR proxy), feasibility (engineering effort rough bands), risk (security/compliance flags).
- Small automation to suggest initial assignee and estimated effort band.

Out-of-scope for MVP: full ML training pipeline, automated quoting, or enforcing rollout policies. This ticket focuses on the taxonomy, scoring rubric, and a lightweight fielded intake flow for reps.
acceptance_criteria: Sales/CS can submit a high-touch ask using the new form; submission creates a Linear ticket with bucket tag
At least 80% of manually reviewed tickets are bucketized correctly (sample of 50) or marked 'needs follow-up'
IRI is computed for each submission and surfaceable in the ticket as three sub-scores + total score
A 'kick-to' recommendation (PM, Solutions Eng, Infra) is suggested for >= 70% of submissions
Documentation (Confluence) describing buckets, IRI formula, and sample decision rules is published
impact_summary: Reduces time-to-first-scope for enterprise asks by removing repetitive clarifying questions and standardizing prioritization signals. Expected to improve response time to high-potential deals and reduce backlog triage load for PMs and Solutions Engineering.
decision_log: 2025-09-16: Chose hybrid heuristic+lightweight classifier for bucketizer to avoid heavy ML infra for MVP (decision by PM + Eng lead)
2025-09-18: IRI will weight econ at 0.5, feasibility 0.3, risk 0.2 for initial rollout; weights configurable later
2025-09-22: Keep security_review_required flag as part of IRI input; any 'high' risk forces manual review by SecOps
